items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: Francis Murray used to tell him about the wild scene in the Cadillac.

ctx.x: You know where the bridge is? Yeah, sure. Where you cross to go to the West End. Yeah. Just that. About two or three blocks. Uh-huh. And it was about two blocks back of the road. That was the Honeysuckle Inn. Oh, what? I went to so, I went to so many places. It's hard to find Tokyo Garden. I don't know. The Shim Sham. And the little club. In fact, I played almost in every club.
But the Cadillac Club. The Cadillac, no. That came along a little later, I guess. Francis Murray used to tell him about the wild scene in the Cadillac.

No, that's one club. I played one job at the Cadillac Club. That was for some kind of a private affair. But that was one night we played in the Cadillac Club. We're a different band all together. See you. But I mean all the rest of the clubs. I guess a hundred of them. Of course now, what we used to call the Timberline District. I never had one day with that at all. That was completely out of my line. I didn't like that.
